ModifyPrepayInstanceSpec.summary: Calls ModifyPrepayInstanceSpec to upgrade or downgrade the instance type of a subscription ENS instance. The new instance type takes effect for the entire lifecycle of the instance.

ModifySecurityGroupAttribute.title: ModifySecurityGroupAttribute
ModifySecurityGroupAttribute.summary: Modifies the information about a security group.

ModifySnapshotAttribute.title: ModifySnapshotAttribute
ModifySnapshotAttribute.summary: Modifies the information about a snapshot.

ModifySnatEntry.title: Modify an SNAT entry
ModifySnatEntry.summary: Invoke the ModifySnatEntry API to modify an SNAT entry.

ModifyVSwitchAttribute.title: ModifyVSwitchAttribute
ModifyVSwitchAttribute.summary: Call ModifyVSwitchAttribute to modify network information.

MountInstanceSDG.title: MountInstanceSDG
MountInstanceSDG.summary: Deploys the SDG that has been attached to instances on the corresponding Android in Container (AIC) instance.

PrepareUpload.title: PrepareUpload
PrepareUpload.summary: Prepares for an upload and retrieves information about the physical storage location.

PushApplicationData.title: PushApplicationData
PushApplicationData.summary: Pushes the business or service data of an application to file servers.

PutBucket.title: PutBucket
PutBucket.summary: Create a bucket for collaborative storage.

PutBucketAcl.title: PutBucketAcl
PutBucketAcl.summary: Modifies the access control list (ACL) of a bucket.

PutBucketLifecycle.title: PutBucketLifecycle
PutBucketLifecycle.summary: You can call the PutBucketLifecycle operation to set lifecycle rules for a bucket.

RebootAICInstance.title: RebootAICInstance
RebootAICInstance.summary: Restarts an Android in Container (AIC) instance.

RebootARMServerInstance.title: RebootARMServerInstance
RebootARMServerInstance.summary: Reboots an Android in Container (AIC) server.

RecoverAICInstance.title: RecoverAICInstance
RecoverAICInstance.summary: Recovers an Android in Container (AIC) instance on the server.

ReinitInstance.title: ReinitInstance
ReinitInstance.summary: Resets an instance based on specific parameters.

ReleaseAICInstance.title: ReleaseAICInstance
ReleaseAICInstance.summary: Releases an Android in Container (AIC) instance from the server.

ReleaseInstance.title: ReleaseInstance
ReleaseInstance.summary: Releases an instance. to release only Elastic IP Addresses (EIPs), Edge Load Balancer (ELB) instances, and cloud disk-based instances. We recommend that you call service-specific operations to release or unsubscribe from instances.

ReleasePrePaidInstance.title: ReleasePrePaidInstance
ReleasePrePaidInstance.summary: Call ReleasePrePaidInstance to delete a subscription instance.

RemoveBackendServers.title: Remove backend servers
RemoveBackendServers.summary: Removes backend servers from a Server Load Balancer (SLB) instance.

RemoveInstanceSDG.title: RemoveInstanceSDG
RemoveInstanceSDG.summary: Removes a shared data group (SDG) that is attached to the compute instance.

RemovePublicIpsFromEpnInstance.title: RemovePublicIpsFromEpnInstance
RemovePublicIpsFromEpnInstance.summary: Removes IP addresses from an edge private network (EPN) instance.

RemoveSDG.title: RemoveSDG
RemoveSDG.summary: Removes a deployed shared data group (SDG) and restore local storage.

RemoveSDGs.title: RemoveSDGs
RemoveSDGs.summary: Removes all versions of SDG and restores the mount to the local disk.

RemoveVSwitchesFromEpnInstance.title: RemoveVSwitchesFromEpnInstance
RemoveVSwitchesFromEpnInstance.summary: Deletes the networking information. This operation is applicable only for instances that reside in the internal network.

RenewARMServerInstance.title: RenewARMServerInstance
RenewARMServerInstance.summary: Renews a subscription Android in Container (AIC) instance.

RescaleApplication.title: Scale an application
RescaleApplication.summary: Calls the RescaleApplication operation to asynchronously scale resources in or out and complete container deployment or release operations.

RescaleDeviceService.title: RescaleDeviceService
RescaleDeviceService.summary: Scales out a bare metal device.

ResetDisk.title: ResetDisk
ResetDisk.summary: Rolls back a disk by using a snapshot.

ResizeDisk.title: ResizeDisk
ResizeDisk.summary: Resizes a pay-as-you-go disk that you purchase.

RevokeSecurityGroup.title: Delete an inbound security group rule
RevokeSecurityGroup.summary: Revokes an inbound rule of a security group to remove the inbound access permission settings.

RevokeSecurityGroupEgress.title: Delete an outbound security group rule
RevokeSecurityGroupEgress.summary: Calls RevokeSecurityGroupEgress to delete an outbound security group rule and revoke outbound access permissions of the security group.

RollbackApplication.title: RollbackApplication
RollbackApplication.summary: Rolls back the container version of a specific application.

RunInstances.title: Batch create instances
RunInstances.summary: Creates pay-as-you-go or subscription ENS compute instances.

RunServiceSchedule.title: RunServiceSchedule
RunServiceSchedule.summary: Schedules the nearest idle resources including instances and pods for your device based on the user ID and IP address and initializes the virtual environment.

SaveSDG.title: SaveSDG
SaveSDG.summary: Saves the disk of a specific device as a shared data group (SDG).

ScaleClusterNodePool.title: ScaleClusterNodePool
ScaleClusterNodePool.summary: Call the ScaleClusterNodePool operation to scale out a node pool, which adds more nodes to support your workloads. The count parameter must be greater than the current number of nodes in the pool. If a node pool contains failed nodes, first call the DeleteClusterNodes operation to remove them before scaling out the pool. A scale-out operation typically completes in 5 to 10 minutes. If the operation takes longer than one hour, it has failed. Contact technical support.

SetBackendServers.title: Set backend server weights
SetBackendServers.summary: Sets the weights of backend servers by calling SetBackendServers.

SetLoadBalancerHTTPListenerAttribute.title: Modify HTTP listener attributes

SetLoadBalancerStatus.title: SetLoadBalancerStatus
SetLoadBalancerStatus.summary: Modifies the status of an Edge Load Balancer (ELB) instance.

SetLoadBalancerTCPListenerAttribute.title: Modify TCP listener attributes
SetLoadBalancerTCPListenerAttribute.summary: Modifies the configuration of a TCP listener.

SetLoadBalancerUDPListenerAttribute.title: SetLoadBalancerUDPListenerAttribute

UnassignPrivateIpAddresses.title: UnassignPrivateIpAddresses
UnassignPrivateIpAddresses.summary: Unassigns secondary private IP addresses from an elastic network interface (ENI).

UnassociateHaVip.title: UnassociateHaVip
UnassociateHaVip.summary: Disassociates a high-availability virtual IP address (HAVIP) from an Edge Node Service (ENS) instance or Elastic Network Interface (ENI).

UnassociateNetworkAcl.title: UnassociateNetworkAcl

UnmountInstanceSDG.title: UnmountInstanceSDG

UntagResources.title: UntagResources
UntagResources.summary: Removes user tags from a resource.

UpgradeAICInstanceImage.summary: Updates the image of an Android in Container (AIC) instance.

UpgradeClusterAddons.title: UpgradeClusterAddons
UpgradeClusterAddons.summary: Call the UpgradeClusterAddons operation to upgrade cluster component instances.

UploadAICPublicKey.title: UploadAICPublicKey
